from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img49 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0049.png"))

# Pose: (2.2071, 3.7071), heading 90 deg (+x)
pole = np.argwhere((img49[:,:,0] > 50) & (img49[:,:,0] < 100) & (img49[:,:,1] > 60) & (img49[:,:,1] < 100) & (img49[:,:,2] > 70) & (img49[:,:,2] < 110) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 300))
print("Obs 49 Pole center x:", pole[:,1].mean(), "width:", pole[:,1].max() - pole[:,1].min())

# Distance to pole:
# In 3D: width_pixels = focal_length * diameter / distance
# With diameter constant, width is proportional to 1/d!
# Let us compare width in obs 42 (width ~ 9, d ~ 2.17m), obs 47 (width 16), obs 49 (width ~ ?)
print("Pole x min:", pole[:,1].min(), "max:", pole[:,1].max())
'
